message.content: {"Q1": {"snippet_ids": ["S1"], "text": "The old capacity limits for the Elm service were 240 concurrent sessions.", "status": "supported"}, "Q2": {"snippet_ids": ["S1"], "text": "The new capacity limits for the Elm service were 315 concurrent sessions.", "status": "supported"}, "Q3": {"snippet_ids": ["S1"], "text": "The absolute increase in capacity limits for the Elm service was 75 concurrent sessions.", "status": "supported"}, "Q4": {"snippet_ids": ["S3"], "text": "The change record does not identify an approver for the increase in capacity limits for the Elm service.", "status": "supported"}, "Q5": {"snippet_ids": ["S2"], "text": "The increase in capacity limits for the Elm service took effect on 14 March.", "status": "supported"}}
